Chapter 7065: Your Creator

Chapter 7065: Your Creator

“Are you all not curious at all?” Li Qiye said calmly.

“Regarding what?” Zhao Dachui couldn’t help but ask.

“The person who brought you all back to this form.” Li Qiye said.

“We already know but will never tell you.” Heaven’s Slayer sneered.

“That simplifies things for me then.” Li Qiye stroked his chin: “But there’s another question I’m sure is on your mind.”

“What? Spill your bullshit since this is your last day.” Heaven’s Demise said.

“About whether you all can actually be revived from this state.” Li Qiye asked.

The four paused since they naturally wanted to know the answer.

“Is it possible?” Zhao Dachui asked, having an extremely strong desire for life.

“How is this current state?” Li Qiye asked.

“Our peak.” Zhao Dachui said.

“More than enough.” Heaven’s Demise said.

‘What if there is something better?” Li Qiye asked.

“Only a true revival is better.” Dragongrasp finally became interested.

“Yes, what you have right now is ugly and crude, just life attached to corpses. It’s all a lie.” Li Qiye said.

“This is the limit, a true revival is impossible.” Zhao Dachui said.

“Limit for others, not mine, I just happen to know the method.” Li Qiye said.

“For even celestial immortals?” Listeners from afar couldn’t believe it.

“Really?” Zhao Dachui lost patience again.

“Do I need to lie?” Li Qiye asked.

“What is your goal?” Heaven’s Slayer uttered coldly.

“Nothing, I just want to rekindle the passion for life within all of you.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Is that so?” Zhao Dachui said skeptically.

“Don’t believe him, he wants to wake up our memories and seize them.” Heaven’s Demise said.

“Taking advantage of corpses.” Dragongrasp said.

“That’s a nasty way of putting it.” Li Qiye sighed and said: “You all are dead and will be destroyed by me again. If you have the slightest longing for life, then memories will come out, all I will do is take a look at them.”

A truly dead person’s memories were inaccessible. This was especially true for celestial immortals. Forcefully opening them would trigger a collapse. However, Li Qiye wanted to stimulate their desire for life and through that, access their memories.

“You will not find what you want from us.” Heaven’s Demise uttered coldly.

“We are dead and know nothing.” Heaven’s Slayer added.

“I’m more interested in his memories than yours.” Li Qiye pointed at Dragongrasp, alarming the cultivator.

“Feel free to tell me more about Hidden Immortal, it will save me a lot of work.” Li Qiye said.

“I know nothing.” Dragongrasp refused.

“Now that’s a lie since I suspect Hidden Immortal birthed you.” Li Qiye smiled.

“What?!” Both the dead and the living shared the same reaction.

“Is that possible?” Zhao Dachui murmured.

Would this imply Hidden Immortal was a woman who had done something monstrous?

“Who is Hidden Immortal?” A few groups talked among themselves about the existence shrouded in fog.

“No.” Dragongrasp denied.

“Really?” Li Qiye gazed at him.

“I don’t need to lie either.” Dragongrasp said.

“True, then who, if not Hidden Immortal?” Li Qiye asked.

“I do not know.” Dragongrasp said.

“Perhaps you are telling the truth but one thing is certain, I am only growing more curious about the person behind this, granting you life and helping you with the dao.” Li Qiye said.

Everyone else shared the same curiosity regarding Dragongrasp’s origin and cultivation path.
